title: Truncation tower reconstructs a quasi-coherent complex

from.place: proof, first step, truncation tower used before applying the derived functor

statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For $n\geq0$ put $E_n=\tau_{\geq-n}E$ using the standard truncation [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Then the canonical map $E\to R\varprojlim_nE_n$ is an isomorphism in the derived category, where $R\varprojlim$ is the derived inverse limit [def-weil-derived-limit]. If $F:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Ab}$ is additive, commutes with countable products, and has a right derived functor $RF$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], then the induced map $RF(E)\to R\varprojlim_nRF(E_n)$ is an isomorphism.
